sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics

However, as you progress through the levels, you'll discover a range of unique twists and challenges that will keep you on your toes. These monsters can be earned through rewards or purchased with in-game currency, and they can be used to clear entire rows or columns, destroy obstacles, or even create new monster matches. However, the catch is that these monsters have limited uses, so you'll need to use them strategically to maximize their impact.

Another important mechanic in Monster Match Master is the use of combos. When you match a set of monsters, you'll earn a combo multiplier that will increase your points. This mechanic encourages players to create long chains of matches, which can be challenging but also incredibly rewarding.
